pages.en:
“————————Ah.”

I run.

I run without understanding what I must do.

As I run, I release the Azoth Sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah”
I run.
I run without understanding what I have to do.
I release the Azoth Sword while I run.

セイ、バー」
駆け寄る。
駆け寄って
セイバーに駆け寄って、その、無抵抗な体に圧しかかった。

pages.en:
“——Sa… ber.”

I rush to her.

I rush to Saber——to Saber—and pin her defenseless body beneath mine.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Sa, ber.”
I run to her.
I run to her and straddle her defenseless body.

“Ah——Shir… ou——?”

Did she strike her head?

Saber looks up at me through a haze.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“AhShi, rou?”
Did she hit her head?
Saber’s looking up at me absent-mindedly.

、あ」
セイバーにはどう映っただろう。
俺は馬乗りになって、短剣を振り上げて、セイバーを見下ろしている。

“————————Ah.”

What must I look like to her?

I straddle her body, dagger raised, staring down into her face.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah.”
How must I look to her?
I’m on top of her, looking down with a dagger upraised.

pages.en:
“————”

Saber's ability to heal herself is extraordinary.

If I do not finish her here, she will recover at once.

Finish her here.

If I do not kill Saber here—wounded, helpless, unable even to stand—she will kill us.

“”

Finish her here.
We’ll be killed unless I kill Saber, who’s wounded and unable to fight back.
